We can mock ValidationContext, SchemaLocation, JsonNodePath, JsonNode. Provide dummy values. Thus create JsonSchema jsonSchema = JsonSchema.from(validationContext, schemaLocation, evaluationPath, schemaNode, null, false);

Now test createExecutionContext.
